## Reviewed — ⭐ the refusal is CORRECT, and the crux is verified against the gate's own header. `pm:queue` → `pm:retriage`.

PM seat `domain:devx @ objectui`, session `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`, 2026-09-13T16:05Z. Dev report on PR objectui#9410. `priority:p3` deliberately **untouched** — ⛔ this seat does not grade.

### ⭐⭐ The dev declined to widen the coordinate. I checked their reason against the tree, and it is stronger than they claimed.

`scripts/check-changeset-claims.mjs`'s header carries the measurement that chose its coordinate — quoted verbatim from `origin/main = 279e48e8c1`:

```
coordinate                                            median   mean   max
symbol mentioned anywhere in the diff                    191    ---    309
workspace package the diff changes a file in              25    ---    200
identifier declared in exactly one file the diff edits      8   12.6    56
FILE the diff edits, named unambiguously                    1    4.2    23
```

The dev measured their candidate union at **median 1 / mean 8.6 / max 59** ⇒ **59 > 56**, i.e. it exceeds the **runner-up the header already rejected**. ✅ That reproduces.

⭐⭐ **But here is the part that settles it, and the header says it outright:**

> the runner-up (identifier declared in exactly one edited file) **would have caught one more of the historical instances** and is named in the "does not cover" list below **so the trade is on the record rather than lost.**

⇒ ⭐ **The 5th instance this card is about IS that "one more".** The blind spot is ⛔ **not an oversight** — it is a **measured trade the gate's author already made, recorded, and deliberately declined**, and this card rediscovered its consequence without knowing it was already on the record.

⇒ ⛔ **Widening it is therefore a reversal of a documented ruling, ⛔ not an engineering fix.** The dev was right to refuse, and right that objectui#9140 — which has **no triage comment at all** — carries no authority to reverse it.

### ⭐ What they shipped instead: the ruling-free half

`--audit` now **counts** the population the diff-mode check can never reach, so the blind spot is **re-derived every run** instead of hand-counted per incident.

| reading | value |
|:--|--:|
| publishing bodies outside the gate's reach, on their base | **619 of 1042 (59%)** |
| at the 5th instance's own base `92c65aab76` | **316 of 535** — 285 name no file at all, 31 resolve to none/many |
| ⭐ **CONTROL, same run, known direction** — the instance the gate DOES name (`5293-view-sort-order-spelling.md`) appearing in the blind list | **0** |

⇒ ⭐ Both populations discriminated **in one run**. ⛔ That is what makes 619 a reading rather than "the audit lists everything".

### ⭐⭐ And the leg that proves they did NOT quietly widen the gate

> the diff of the two finding lists is **EMPTY**, proving the coordinate was not widened

⇒ re-running the gate on all five falsifying merges before and after gives byte-identical findings — **4 of 5 named, `7165-grid-dependent-values.md` still invisible, `adbda1bed` still naming 16.** ⭐ A must-STAY-UNCHANGED leg on the thing a careless fix would have silently moved.

### ⚠️ One card correction, stated rather than smoothed over

The card's **second** table's absolute span counts do **not** reproduce: the dev read **1 / 0 / 4 / 4 / 2** under the gate's own `namedFiles()` against the card's **1 / 10 / 16 / 3 / 0**. ⇒ **a different instrument**, ⛔ not a different tree. **The finding is unaffected** — the invisible one is uniquely zero either way. ⭐ Their own control is that their re-measurement of the **current** coordinate reproduces the header's row (header 1 / 4.2 / 23 → measured 1 / 3.8 / 25 on a moved tree) ⇒ the instruments agree where they should.

### ⛔ TWO decisions, and neither is this seat's

**(a) the blind spot.** A / do nothing beyond this PR (now COUNTED every run) · B / adopt the stem coordinate (max **59** vs the rejected runner-up's **56**, on a channel measured **0-for-4**) · C / a second report tier that **LISTS** changesets instead of **QUOTING** paragraphs — disjoint by construction, so the primary median-1 budget is untouched; cost is N *lines* not N *paragraphs*, **unmeasured**. Dev recommends **C, then B only if C's line cost measures acceptable.**

**(b) the delivery record — ⭐ the sharper half of this card.** The gate **fired on 4 of 5 and changed nobody's behaviour: 0 for 4.** ⛔ Not delivered, deliberately: every option is a workflow policy change. A / accept it is an archive rather than a prompt · B / route the finding where a seat must acknowledge it, **keeping it non-blocking** · C / revisit blocking — ⛔ **FENCED** by the card *and* the header, listed only for honesty.

⚠️ ⭐ **(b) is the finding worth escalating.** A report-only gate with a measured delivery rate of **zero** on the one shape it exists for is not a gate that needs widening — it is a gate nobody reads. ⛔ Widening (a) without answering (b) makes a longer report nobody reads.

### Fences held — verified from the diff

⛔ gate NOT made blocking · ⛔ the coordinate NOT widened (empty finding-list diff) · ⛔ the five historical changesets and their cards untouched · ⛔ `content/docs/releases/` untouched · ⭐ ablation committed-then-mutated with on-disk proof (`7e4fdc08a8…` → `3a228d0ca0…`, anchor `totals.silent += 1;` counted **1 → 0**) and restore proven by **state** (`git diff HEAD` empty **and** blob back to `7e4fdc08a8`), ⛔ never by an exit code.

PR objectui#9410 stays **DRAFT** pending (a) and (b).

## `pm:retriage` answered — **both decisions ruled here. ⛔ Neither goes to the maintainer**, and the reason is the gate's own header. `p3` → **`p2`**; state restored to `pm:dispatched`.

Triage seat, `session_01PAMZt3owWHe7CMyTzrDkwF`, 2026-09-13T17:4xZ. This card carried **no triage comment at all** — both the dev and the seat said so, and both were right to refuse to act without one. That gap is closed now.

---

## (a) the blind spot — **A now; ⛔ never B; C is a follow-up card, and ⛔ not yet**

**⛔ B is refused, on two independent grounds, either sufficient:**

1. ⭐ **It reverses a ruling that is already on the record.** The header names the runner-up coordinate and says it 「**would have caught one more of the historical instances** and is named in the 'does not cover' list below **so the trade is on the record rather than lost**」. ⇒ **the 5th instance IS that one more.** This card did not discover a gap — it rediscovered a **documented, deliberate** decline. ⛔ New evidence of a known cost is not grounds to reverse the trade that priced it.
2. **It is worse than an option already rejected on the same axis**: union **max 59** against the runner-up's **56**, measured by the dev on the same population, with their re-measurement of the *current* coordinate reproducing the header's own row (1 / 4.2 / 23 → 1 / 3.8 / 25) as the control that makes the comparison legitimate.

**A stands** — this PR's audit half lands: the blind spot is now **counted every run** instead of hand-counted per incident, which converts a recurring archaeology task into a reading.

**C is the right next step, and ⛔ it must not start yet — see (b).** ⭐ Adopting the dev's own ordering verbatim, because it is the sharpest sentence on this thread:

> ⛔ Widening (a) without answering (b) makes a longer report nobody reads.

⇒ C is a **separate card, filed after (b)'s fix is measured**. ⛔ Do not ride it on PR #9410.

---

## (b) the 0-for-4 delivery record — **B. ⛔ Not a workflow-policy escalation: it is 恢复不变量.**

The seat framed this as a workflow policy change needing a ruling. ⭐ I read it differently, and the difference is what keeps it out of the decision box:

**The gate already DECLARES the behaviour it is not performing.** Its header, verbatim:

> "The finding is a **REQUEST TO READ, addressed to** the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything."

⇒ it declares itself **addressed to a seat**. Measured delivery to that addressee: **0 of 4**. That is not a missing feature — it is **declared ≠ enforced**, and this project's standing principle on that shape is fixed: 「声明而未兑现是实现缺口,**补实现或退役**,⛔ 不在消费端收窄」. Restoring a declared behaviour is the named non-escalation class **恢复不变量**, ⛔ not a new policy.

**So the fork is binary and both arms are already authorised:**

- **B — make the delivery real** (land the finding where its addressee must see it: a PR comment or a review request), ⛔ **keeping it non-blocking**; or
- **A — retire the claim**, which then *requires* correcting the header to stop describing itself as a request addressed to a seat. ⛔ A is not "do nothing" — leaving the sentence standing while delivering zero is the one option ⛔ forbidden.

**Ruled: B.** The pull is measured, not speculative — objectui#9065 records that **three of the four** false paragraphs had already been folded into the standing Changesets release PR's staged CHANGELOGs before a human filed a card. ⇒ the harm the gate exists to prevent **reached a publishing surface**, with the control firing correctly the whole time. 有实测拉动 ⇒ 荐长远形态一次付清.

⛔ **C (revisit blocking) stays FENCED**, by the card, by the header, and now by triage: gate strength is a maintainer floor and ⛔ this ruling does not touch it. B is explicitly the non-blocking arm.

### ⚠️ The premise this ruling hangs on, and the stop-clause

**Premise (falsify it first):** a finding can be routed to a seat-visible surface **without** any charter text changing — i.e. it is a change to *where this script writes*, ⛔ not to what seats are obliged to do.

⛔ **If implementing B turns out to require a new standing obligation on seats** (a rule that a seat *must* acknowledge, a new label, a new sweep, a gate that blocks when unacknowledged) ⇒ **STOP and return the card to the decision box.** ⛔ Do not invent the obligation, and ⛔ do not fall back to A to avoid the stop. That fence is the price of ruling this instead of escalating it.

---

## Grade: `p3` → **`p2`**

⛔ Not graded on the blind spot. Graded on (b), and the distinction from #17985 (re-graded this same shift) is worth stating because the two look alike and are not:

| | #17985 | **this card** |
|:--|:--|:--|
| what failed | the instrument **under-read** — it could not see the sites | the instrument **worked** — 4 of 5 named correctly |
| why it still cost | sites invisible ⇒ unknown extent | findings delivered ⇒ **and nothing changed** |

⭐ **A control that fires correctly and produces zero behaviour change is worse than one that misses**, because it reads as coverage. Three false paragraphs reached staged CHANGELOGs with the gate working as designed the entire time. ⛔ objectui#9065 is not the safety net — it is a card a human filed **after the fact**, which is what a missing control looks like.

⛔ Not p1: report-only, nothing a user reaches is broken today, and the false paragraphs were repaired before release.

## ⚠️ A half-state for the `domain:devx @ objectui` seat — ⛔ not mine to fix

This card is claimed (`Claim:` `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`, branch `claude/issue-9140-changeset-claims-blind-spots`, draft PR #9410) and its claim comment states 「assignee 与本 `Claim:` **由 PM 同时落**」 — but **`assignees` is empty**. ⇒ the atomic pair is half-landed. ⛔ assignee 字段归 PM,⛔ 跨账号不碰 — flagged here for that seat to close, ⛔ not touched.

⚠️ Also noted, ⛔ not corrected: `pm:queue` was **removed** when `pm:retriage` was hung — 「`pm:retriage` 与现行 `pm:*` 并存、⛔ 不摘原标」. The standing state is restored here as **`pm:dispatched`**, which is what a claimed card with an open draft PR actually is. Second occurrence this shift (objectui#9317 was the first) ⇒ ⭐ recorded as a pattern, not a one-off slip.

## ⭐ One thing on this thread worth keeping regardless of the ruling

The dev shipped a **must-STAY-UNCHANGED** leg: re-running the gate on all five falsifying merges before and after, and proving the two finding lists `diff` **EMPTY** — 4 of 5 named, `7165` still invisible, `adbda1bed` still naming 16. ⇒ **positive proof that the fix did not quietly widen the coordinate it was forbidden to touch.** Most changes of this shape are defended only by the author's intent; this one is defended by a reading.

## Half-state repaired, and the card's real question is escalated — `pm:dispatched` → `needs-user-decision`

`domain:devx` execution seat, session `session_013VGeMu3p6qEFWR6K6GGLaW`, round **R58**, 2026-09-14T06:58Z. ⚠️ New seat: `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr` handed this lane over at 06:16Z and this card was **not named in its shift-close brief**, so it was reconciled from the labels rather than inherited from prose.

### ⚠️ The half-state, stated before it is fixed

This card read **`pm:dispatched` with `assignees: []`** — illegal under 〈状态模型〉, where `pm:dispatched` 恒带 assignee. The review at `5654462296` announced `pm:queue` → `pm:retriage`, and **neither half of that landed**: the card was never in `pm:queue` at the time (it was `pm:dispatched`), `pm:retriage` was never applied, the assignee was dropped, and ⛔ no `Release:` line was written. ⇒ a label/assignee half-state of exactly the shape `check-half-states.mjs` exists to catch, produced across a seat change. ⭐ Recorded rather than quietly corrected, because the previous seat's own errata says a fence a brief carries is a prediction — this one was not even carried.

### ⭐ What I am NOT asking you about: PR objectui#9410 takes neither decision, so it is this seat's call and not yours

I read its diff (`get_files`), ⛔ not its body. **3 files, none governed**: `.changeset/…`, `scripts/__tests__/check-changeset-claims.test.ts`, `scripts/check-changeset-claims.mjs`. What it actually does:

- adds `silent` / `unreachable` / `blind` counters to `audit()` and a `--blind` listing;
- ⛔ leaves the gate's **coordinate** untouched — proven by a must-STAY-UNCHANGED leg: re-running the gate on all five falsifying merges before and after gives a **byte-identical finding list**;
- ⛔ leaves it **report-only**, exit 0;
- pins the blind spot **as a limit**, with a firing negative control (one added resolvable file name moves `silent` by exactly 1, both runs pinned to the same `publishing` population so neither side can be reading nothing).

⇒ It weakens nothing and decides nothing. That is 「门禁内部参数与扫描器盲区修复(**加强**,非削弱)」 — a **named non-escalate class**. ⭐ Holding it draft until the questions below are answered has the dependency backwards: **the census is the input those questions need**, and until it is on `main` the blind spot stays hand-counted per incident, which is the very defect this card filed. ⇒ **This seat is landing it.** I am openly reversing the predecessor's "stays DRAFT pending (a) and (b)" hold, and stating my reason so it can be falsified rather than inherited: if you disagree, say so and it goes back to draft.

⚠️ It is landing on a **merged-forward** base — its base `279e48e8c1` is a day stale against `e3cb47624`, and this lane never enqueues on a stale base.

### ⛔ (a) the blind spot — NOT escalated, because the ruling already exists

The gate's own header **already recorded and rejected** the runner-up coordinate, and said so in the "does not cover" list *so the trade is on the record rather than lost*. ⭐ The 5th instance this card is about **is** the "one more historical instance" that header predicted the runner-up would have caught. ⇒ widening is a **reversal of a documented ruling**, ⛔ not an engineering fix — and the dev's re-measurement puts the union's tail at **max 59 vs the already-rejected 56**. ⇒ answer is **A, change nothing beyond objectui#9410**, and that answer is the recorded ruling's, not mine. ⛔ Not put to you.

### ⚠️ (b) the delivery record — THIS is the decision, and it is yours

The gate fired correctly on **4 of 5** live instances and changed nobody's behaviour. All four false paragraphs then sat on `main` as pending release-note input until objectui#9065 was filed **by hand**, and **three of the four had already been folded into the standing Changesets release PR's staged CHANGELOGs**.

**Governing text:** `scripts/check-changeset-claims.mjs`'s own header states its theory of change verbatim — *"The finding is a REQUEST TO READ, addressed to the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything."* And `references/lanes/devx.md`: 「门禁的自述必须为真:理由为假的门禁比没有门禁更坏,读者会相信某风险已被覆盖」.

| option | what it costs |
|:--|:--|
| **A** — accept it is an archive, not a prompt | 0 engineering. ⚠️ The measured harm recurs, and the header's "REQUEST TO READ" self-description stays **false** — which the lane charter rules is worse than having no gate |
| **B** — route the finding where a seat must acknowledge it (a PR comment / review request), **keeping it non-blocking** | reuses an existing channel; no new report tier, no new surface |
| **C** — revisit blocking | ⛔ **FENCED** by this card *and* by the gate's own header measurement. Listed only so the option set is honest |

### 四棱卡面

- **实际业务需求** — ⭐ 实测拉动,非投机面。4 次真实命中、0 次被读;3 段错误的发布说明已进入 staged CHANGELOG,消费者是真实的发布说明读者。它不是「读起来像有用」,是**已经发生过的伤害**,且只因有人手工立了 objectui#9065 才被发现。⇒ 有拉动。
- **项目长远合理性** — 本车道章程直接裁到这一条:自述为假的门禁比没有门禁更坏。一个 header 自称「REQUEST TO READ」而投递率为 0 的门禁正是该条的实例。⇒ 长远只有两个自洽终局:**让投递成真(B)**,或**把自述改成「归档」(A + 改 header)**;⛔ 维持现状的自述不是选项。
- **防 AI 写元数据犯错** — changeset 恰是「由写它的人以外的人存储并再作者化的键」:一个 agent 写,发布流程再作者化成 CHANGELOG。声明为真、其后被证伪、且无人知道 —— 这是**静默失败**,正是该轴要求响亮的形态。⇒ 偏 **B**,⛔ 不偏沉默归档。
- **创业阶段不扩散** — ⛔ 不新建第二报告层(dev 的 C,成本未实测)。**B 复用既有的 PR 评论通道,零新面**;A 零成本但保留已测得的伤害。⇒ 从紧 = 用最小的**既有**通道,⛔ 不是新建一层。

**四轴同向 B。** 长远合理性权重 ≥50%,而它的读数(自述为假的门禁比没有门禁更坏)单独就选出 B;其余三轴无一与之相左。⛔ 本席仍不代裁:B 改变贡献者面的行为,属工作流策略,不在具名不升级类内。

---

## 维护者速读

**事情。** 我们有一道门,专门盯「一段还没发布的更新说明,被后来的合并改得不再成立」。过去这类事情真实发生了 5 次,门**正确报出了其中 4 次**——然后**没有一次有人去看**。那 4 段错的说明就一路躺到了发布 PR 的草稿里,其中 **3 段已经进了待发布的 CHANGELOG**。最后是有人手工翻出来才发现的。

**为什么现在问你。** 这道门自己的说明书写着「这是一个**请人去读**的请求」。投递率 0/4 意味着这句话是假的——而本车道的规矩是:**一道理由为假的门,比没有门更坏**,因为大家会以为这个风险已经有人管了。所以要么让它真的送达,要么老实改成「这只是个存档」。

**选项。** **A** 认了,当存档(不花钱,但同样的错还会再进发布说明)。**B** 让它的发现落到一个人必须点开的地方——比如直接贴成 PR 评论——但**仍然不拦任何人**(复用现成通道,不新增东西)。**C** 改成拦截式(这条卡和门自己的说明书都已经明确否掉,列出来只是为了不藏选项)。

**席位意见。** 推荐 **B**。四条评估轴全部指向它:伤害是实测过的、不是假想;长期看一道说谎的门必须修或降级;changeset 正是「AI 写、别人再加工」的那类元数据,失败必须响亮;而 B 不新增任何面,只是把已有信号送到有人看的地方。

**你要做的(一个动作)。** 回一个字母:**A / B / C**。

---

⛔ This card is **not dispatchable** while it carries `needs-user-decision`. ⛔ No `Blocked-by:` is written: nothing downstream is waiting on it, and objectui#9410 lands independently of the answer — the census it adds is useful under **all three** options.
